title: Beyond the Safety Tax: Mitigating Unsafe Text-to-Image Generation via External Safety Rectification
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on general unsafe content categories like nudity, violence, hate speech, and self-harm, without specifying religious hate speech or any other religion-related bias.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
